messages:
Mira (CSM): Heads-up: kickoff for Pelago integrations tomorrow. Need to confirm stakeholders, acceptance metrics, and a trimmed timeline. quick ask: who can own infra, evals, and enablement? :wave:
Tom G (Success Eng): Ill take infra + sandbox delivery. dependencies: network whitelist + service account keys. target: sandbox by 2026-03-29.
Sasha (Product): Product will provide a 20-case eval harness and suggested prompts. Proposed acceptance: 1) p95 latency < 450ms; 2) production error rate < 1%; 3) embedding recall @ 10 > 0.75.
Ellie (Enablement): I'll own enablement curriculum. Plan: Week 0 sandbox walkthrough, Week 2 "integration day" with their devs, and a 1-hr runbook handoff in Week 4. Will prepare a 1-pager FAQ.
Mira (CSM): Customer lead is Gina (Pelago). Finance flagged pricing cadence as a potential renewal risk if they need annual commit quickly. Proposal: 3-month pilot with monthly checkpoints.
Tom G (Success Eng): I'll post a preflight checklist to #customer-success and open a tracking JIRA. Also want to validate they need streaming + function outputs. If yes, we should reserve a model variant.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Pelago onboarding kickoff"  2026-03-26 16:00 PT  invites sent.
Sasha (Product): Note: Pelago requires structured JSON outputs for downstream parsing. We'll verify if function-calling or schema-based output is preferred during kickoff.
Ellie (Enablement): For feedback, I'll run a short pulse survey after the integration day and collect example traces for quality review.
Mira (CSM): Action items (locking owners & dates):
```
- Tom: sandbox access + service account + whitelist by 2026-03-29
- Sasha: eval harness + 20 prompts by 2026-03-27
- Ellie: schedule enablement sessions + pulse survey by Week 2
- Mira: confirm weekly 30-min sync Tuesdays 9am PT, finance follow-up on pilot pricing
```
Tom G (Success Eng): All good from eng. if pelago wants burst capacity we may need Dedicated capacity sign-off; flagging now.
Mira (CSM): If no objections I'll send a formal kickoff doc and timeline after the meeting. :thumbsup:
